import sqlite3
db = sqlite3.connect\('data/policy.db'\)
db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
w_count = db.execute\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM winners2022'\).fetchone\(\)[0]
p_count = db.execute\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM winner_pledges2022'\).fetchone\(\)[0]
print\(f'당선인: {w_count}명, 공약: {p_count}개'\)
print\(\)

    print\(f'  {r[0]} / {r[1]} / {r[2]} \(코드={r[3]}\)'\)
print\(\)
print\('--- 공약 샘플 \(3개\) ---'\)
rows = db.execute\('''
    SELECT w.name, w.position, wp.title, wp.content

    LIMIT 3
'''\).fetchall\(\)

import sys, io
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper\(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8'\)

# user_meta 없는 경우 \(지역 미선택\) 테스트
from backend.openai_vector_store import search_winners2022_from_db, reconstruct_winner_identity

hits = search_winners2022_from_db\('청년 일자리 창출', user_meta=None, top_k=3\)
print\(f'[user_meta 없음] {len\(hits\)}건'\)
for score, fn, text, meta in hits:
    position, name = reconstruct_winner_identity\(meta, text\)
    print\(f'  {name} / {position} - 확인불가:{\\"확인불가\\" in name or \\"확인불가\\" in position}'\)

# 기초단체장 케이스
hits2 = search_winners2022_from_db\('도로 보수 및 교통 안전', {'election_type': 'local_mayor', 'region_province': '경기'}, top_k=3\)
print\(f'[기초단체장/경기] {len\(hits2\)}건'\)
for score, fn, text, meta in hits2:
    position, name = reconstruct_winner_identity\(meta, text\)
    print\(f'  {name} / {position}'\)
